name: Notify the billing team when an invoice payment fails

parameters.content:
## Notify the billing team when an invoice payment fails

When a payment attempt on an invoice is refused, this workflow reads the invoice from LetzBill and emails its number, customer, and amount to your billing team.

### Set up
1. Install the community package `@altarys/n8n-nodes-letzbill`.
2. Select a **LetzBill API** credential in both LetzBill nodes. The key needs **Read**, **Write**, and **Delete** for webhooks and **Read** for invoices.
3. Select an SMTP credential in both email nodes.
4. Change the addresses in **Settings**.
5. Publish the workflow.

If the invoice can't be read, the second email still tells the team which event failed.

Amounts are divided by 100, which is right for two-decimal currencies such as EUR. For other currencies, see the minor units table in the guide.

Guide: https://github.com/helmajbri/altarys-n8n-nodes/blob/main/packages/letzbill/docs/examples.md

### 1. Read the invoice
The event names the invoice. **Get invoice** reads its number, customer, and amount, and retries three times.

### 2. Notify the team
The first email goes out when the invoice was read. The second one goes out when it couldn't be read.
